normalized.description: The EU Capability Development Priorities endorsed by the EU Ministers of Defence in November 2023 contain three (3) priorities related to the land domain, one (1) priority related to logistics, including AM, and one (1) priority related to CBRN defence: - Ground Combat Capabilities (GCC); - Future Soldier Systems (FSS); - Land Based Precision Engagement (LBPE); - Sustainable and Agile Logistics (SAL); - CBRN Defence. The present call for tenders aims to ensure contractual support for the implementation of the above mentioned priorities over a period of four (4) years. The capability development areas to be covered are: - Lot I: GCC - Lot II: FSS - Lot III: LBPE - Lot IV: SAL - Lot V: AM-enabled Military Capabilities - Lot VI: CBRN Defence For each individual LOT I – VI and their respective capability development areas abovementioned, the specific objectives are twofold: - Provision of studies and support for concept development - Provision of event management services
